notes: Sync conflict dialog: each side now shows who last changed the value and when, under the Jira and FogBugz columns — so the 'suggested' master (most-recently-changed wins) is backed by visible evidence you can check before applying. Fixed the FogBugz 'last changed' detection: status, assignee and fix-version changes were never recognised (the matcher used the wrong field-change wording), so only the Jira side showed a date/author. Status and assignee now key off the FogBugz event verb, and fix-version off the 'Milestone' change text, matching the legacy tool. FogBugz → Jira: the new Jira issue now gets a web link back to the FogBugz case (it already worked the other way round). Shown as a 'FogBugz link' pill in the result panel.
